newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FOWLER SCORES FOUR AS LIVERPOOL CRUSH BORO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOWLER SCORES FOUR AS LIVERPOOL CRUSH BORO.

text.p: Robbie Fowler scored four times as Liverpool crushed Middlesbrough 5-1 at Anfield to move into second place in the English premier league on Saturday.
Fowler's second was his 100th goal for the club in only 165 matches. Stig Inge Bjornebye was Liverpool's other goalscorer while the re-called Stan Collymore made four of the five.

Wimbledon beat Blackburn 1-0 with an 85th minute goal from substitute Dean Holdsworth, but despite chalking up their 19th game without defeat the Dons slipped to third behind Liverpool on goal difference.
Leeds and Tottenham drew 0-0 at Elland Road in the only other premier league match played due to international call-ups.
Arsenal stayed top on 35 points, with both Liverpool and Wimbledon on 34. The top three have all played 17 matches.
